packageRules.description: TypeScript stays on 6.x. typescript-eslint 8.72.1 (latest on 2026-11-01) declares peer typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' and throws 'typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0' when eslint-config-next loads it, so npm run lint fails. Remove once a stable typescript-eslint accepts TS 7 (typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940).

The effect override stays on 3.x. uploadthing 7.7.4 (latest on 2026-11-01) pins effect 3.17.7, and forcing effect 4 breaks next build ('Can't resolve effect/ConfigError') and tsc (UploadedFileData.ufsUrl). Remove once uploadthing supports effect 4.
